messages.author: 9d8881f409886531
messages.subject: timing of the bouts
parts:
Hi all,

Is it possible to obtain information about the timing of when each MVPA bout happened on a day-level analysis? For example, the information would tell me that there was a bout of MVPA on day 1 from 1pm to 1.30pm.  I am interested in finding out when each subject engaged in a bout of MVPA to be able to pair it with self-report data that I obtained with experience sampling.

Best regards,
Marta

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] timing of the bouts
parts:
Hi Marta,

Easiest  approach may be to export the time series in part5 (see arguments: save_ms5rawlevels, save_ms5raw_format, and save_ms5raw_without_invalid), which gives you for each epoch the behavioural class (e.g. a bout of a certain length category), see class_id in https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html. Based on this you can derive the time and overlap self-report data.

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
